title: Centered 9-sector orthogonal lattice (`three ranks by three files`) rendered with glowing architectural dividers, sector coordinate mapping, and dual Mouse-Click + Keyboard (`WASD`/`Arrows` + `SPACE`) sector selection.
author_role: Lead Procedural Level Designer (Entity spawning, spatial pacing, hazard/gate placement)
summary: Constructs the 360x360px centered 9-sector orthogonal lattice at (400, 310) with glowing dividers, sector collision bounds, and dual mouse/keyboard cursor navigation.
technical_specification: Initialize `state.world.matrix = { x: 220, y: 130, size: 360, cellSize: 120, selectedIndex: 4 }`. Each cell index `i` maps to `row = Math.floor(i / 3)`, `col = i % 3`, center `cx = 220 + col * 120 + 60`, `cy = 130 + row * 120 + 60`. On keydown (WASD/Arrows), clamp `selectedIndex` across ranks/files with wrapping/clamping logic. On mousemove, if `pointer.x/y` is inside lattice bounds, update `selectedIndex = Math.floor((pointer.y - 130) / 120) * 3 + Math.floor((pointer.x - 220) / 120)`. Render lattice dividers as dual-stroke neon lines with bloom at `x = 340, 460` and `y = 250, 370`.
acceptance_criteria: Lattice renders exactly centered at x:400, y:310 with 9 distinct 120x120px interactive sectors.
Navigating with WASD or Arrow keys immediately moves the sector selection reticle to adjacent cells.
Hovering the mouse inside any sector updates the selection reticle to that sector's coordinate.
